DRV = r'''
import torch, ctypes, numpy as np, b200probe, math
PTRS = "x dww dwb lnw lnb w1 b1 gw gb w2 b2 out xh part hidden sumsq w1h w2h s1 c1 c2".split()
INTS1 = "B C H W HW M Mp C4 nparts".split()
INTS2 = "p1_mode p1_twr p1_tiles p1_lpr p1_rg p1_hb p1_wb p1_cpw cfg2 cfg3 split3 mask force_split".split()
class Params(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [(n, ctypes.c_void_p) for n in PTRS] + [(n, ctypes.c_int) for n in INTS1] + [("eps", ctypes.c_float), ("ln_eps", ctypes.c_float)] + [(n, ctypes.c_int) for n in INTS2] + [("ts", ctypes.c_void_p)]
def make_inputs(B, C, H, W, seed=0):
    g = torch.Generator(device='cuda').manual_seed(seed)
    r = lambda *s: torch.randn(*s, device='cuda', generator=g)
    C4 = 4 * C
    return [r(B, C, H, W), r(C, 1, 7, 7) / math.sqrt(7), r(C), torch.ones(C, device='cuda'), torch.zeros(C, device='cuda'),
            r(C4, C) / math.sqrt(C), r(C4), r(1, 1, 1, C4) / math.sqrt(C4), r(1, 1, 1, C4), r(C, C4) / math.sqrt(C4), r(C)]
def reference(x, dww, dwb, lnw, lnb, w1, b1, gw, gb, w2, b2):
    C = x.shape[1]
    d = torch.nn.functional.conv2d(x, dww, dwb, padding=3, groups=C).permute(0, 2, 3, 1)
    a = torch.nn.functional.layer_norm(d, (C,), lnw, lnb, 1e-6)
    h = torch.nn.functional.gelu(a @ w1.t() + b1)
    gx = torch.norm(h, p=2, dim=(1, 2), keepdim=True); nx = gx / (gx.mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6)
    h = gw * (h * nx) + gb + h
    y = h @ w2.t() + b2
    return x + y.permute(0, 3, 1, 2)
def al(v): return (v + 255) & ~255
class Runner:
    def __init__(self, so):
        self.lib = ctypes.CDLL(so); self.lib.convnext_launch.restype = ctypes.c_char_p
        self.lib.convnext_launch.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(Params), ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int)]
        self.info = (ctypes.c_int * 16)()
        self.ws_extra = 0
    def __call__(self, x, dww, dwb, lnw, lnb, w1, b1, gw, gb, w2, b2, out, mask=7, ts=None, extra=None):
        B, C, H, W = x.shape; HW = H * W; M = B * HW; C4 = 4 * C; Mp = ((M + 127) // 128) * 128
        o_xh = 0; o_part = al(o_xh + C * Mp * 2); o_hid = al(o_part + (C // 8) * Mp * 8); o_sq = al(o_hid + C4 * Mp * 2)
        o_w1h = al(o_sq + B * C4 * 4); o_w2h = al(o_w1h + C * C4 * 2); o_s1 = al(o_w2h + C4 * C * 2); o_c1 = al(o_s1 + C4 * 4)
        o_c2 = al(o_c1 + C4 * 4); tot = al(o_c2 + C * 4) + self.ws_extra
        ws = torch.empty(tot, dtype=torch.uint8, device='cuda'); wp = ws.data_ptr()
        p = Params()
        for n, t in zip(PTRS[:12], [x, dww, dwb, lnw, lnb, w1, b1, gw, gb, w2, b2, out]): setattr(p, n, t.data_ptr())
        p.xh = wp + o_xh; p.part = wp + o_part; p.hidden = wp + o_hid; p.sumsq = wp + o_sq; p.w1h = wp + o_w1h; p.w2h = wp + o_w2h
        p.s1 = wp + o_s1; p.c1 = wp + o_c1; p.c2 = wp + o_c2
        p.B, p.C, p.H, p.W, p.HW, p.M, p.Mp, p.C4, p.nparts = B, C, H, W, HW, M, Mp, C4, C // 32
        p.eps = 1e-6; p.ln_eps = 1e-6; p.mask = mask; p.force_split = 0; p.split3 = 1
        p.ts = ts.data_ptr() if ts is not None else None
        self.ws = ws
        err = self.lib.convnext_launch(ctypes.byref(p), torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream, self.info)
        if err: raise RuntimeError(err)
def stamps(run, shape, idx, mask=7):
    ins = make_inputs(*shape); out = torch.empty_like(ins[0])
    run(*ins, out, mask=mask); torch.cuda.synchronize()
    ts = torch.zeros(1024 * 32, dtype=torch.int64, device='cuda')
    b200probe.flush_l2(); torch.cuda.synchronize()
    run(*ins, out, mask=mask, ts=ts); torch.cuda.synchronize()
    G = run.info[0]; a = ts.view(-1, 32)[:G].cpu().numpy().astype(np.int64)
    gt = a[:, :16]; ck = a[:, 16:]; t0 = gt[:, 0].min()
    res = []
    for i in idx:
        v = gt[:, i]; m = v > 0
        if m.sum() == 0: continue
        res.append("%d:%.1f/%.1f(%d)" % (i, np.median(v[m] - t0) / 1e3, (v[m].max() - t0) / 1e3, m.sum()))
    m = (gt[:, 12] > 0) & (gt[:, 0] > 0)
    ghz = np.median((ck[m, 12] - ck[m, 0]) / (gt[m, 12] - gt[m, 0]))
    return " ".join(res) + " clk %.2fGHz" % ghz
def check(run, shape, seed=1):
    ins = make_inputs(*shape, seed=seed); out = torch.zeros_like(ins[0])
    run(*ins, out); torch.cuda.synchronize()
    ref = reference(*ins); e = (out - ref).abs()
    return float(e.max()), int((e > 2.4e-3).sum())
def htime(run, shape, mask=7):
    ins = make_inputs(*shape); out = torch.empty_like(ins[0])
    return b200probe.harness_time(lambda *a: run(*a, mask=mask), ins, [out])
'''
